title: TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. translated_title: TOPS：重塑多任务机器人操作中的流源与传输路径
translated_abstract: 基于流的策略在语言条件化的多任务操作中，通常在各个任务间共享单一的高斯源先验和共同的线性传输路径。然而，对于共享策略而言，可靠地执行具有不同运动需求的多个任务仍然充满挑战。我们提出了TOPS（任务导向先验与调度，Task-Oriented Priors and Schedules），它无需修改网络架构，即可为每个任务适配流源先验和插值调度。TOPS首先从逆向映射的专家动作序列构建多模态任务源，使语言指令能够选择生成过程的起始位置。在源-目标协方差失配的引导下，该方法在去噪早期减慢向专家动作过渡的速度，并在后期沿需要扩展的方向加速过渡。在高斯端点模型下，我们的分析表明这种调度调整……
tldr: 提出TOPS方法，在不修改网络架构的前提下，通过为每个任务定制流匹配的源先验和插值调度（利用专家动作逆向映射构建多模态任务源，并依据源-目标协方差失配调整传输节奏），提升语言条件化多任务机器人操作性能。
en_tdlr: TOPS improves language-conditioned multi-task robot manipulation by adapting the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture.
